title: Frontend + Classifier full-system integration simulation
context: Frontend (0.9V subthreshold, 8 analog feature outputs) and classifier (1.8V, 8-64-5 MLP on 1T1R ReRAM crossbar) have never been simulated as one SPICE netlist. Interface effects (loading, settling, noise coupling) are uncharacterized. Also absorbs deferred MAJOR-008 frontend items: bias_gen startup circuit and LDO/voltage regulator.

success_criteria.target: ngspice transient simulation completes without convergence failure for >= 3 ECG beats
success_criteria.measurement_method: Run ngspice on combined_system.spice with .tran, verify 'done' in output and no 'singular matrix' or 'timestep too small'

success_criteria.target: 0.9V frontend supply within +/-5% (0.855V to 0.945V) under frontend load
success_criteria.measurement_method: Measure v(vdd_frontend) during transient, check min/max over simulation

success_criteria.target: bias_gen produces vbias within 10% of 0.30V target without any .ic statements (zero initial conditions)
success_criteria.measurement_method: Measure v(vbias) in .op or early transient, compare to 0.30V reference. No .ic v(xbias.iref)=... allowed.

success_criteria.target: All 8 frontend feature outputs produce voltages in range 0.05V-0.85V (within 0.9V rail) during transient
success_criteria.measurement_method: Extract min/max of f1-f8 over transient simulation
success_criteria.current_value: Standalone frontend produces features in ~0.13V-0.48V range

success_criteria.target: WTA winner (argmax of v(out0)-v(out4)) matches standalone classifier prediction for >= 2 out of 3 test beats
success_criteria.measurement_method: Sample WTA outputs at feature-valid times (after delay timer settles), compare argmax to standalone test
success_criteria.current_value: Standalone WTA: out2 is winner (class V) for test record 100

success_criteria.target: Only external inputs: VDD=1.8V and ECG electrodes (elec_l0_p, elec_l0_n, elec_l1_p, elec_l1_n). Zero .ic statements.
success_criteria.measurement_method: Audit combined netlist for .ic, ideal I-sources, or V-sources other than VDD, electrode signals, and threshold references
success_criteria.current_value: Frontend needs .ic for bias_gen startup, timer caps, EWMA caps

success_criteria.target: WTA winner-to-runner-up voltage margin >= 5mV at measurement time
success_criteria.measurement_method: Extract v(out0)-v(out4) at feature-valid time, compute winner margin

constraints: Must use SKY130 130nm CMOS devices only
No digital elements in signal path — fully analog system
Feature reorder: Frontend [F1,F2,F3,F4,F5,F6,F7,F8] maps to Classifier rows [0,3,1,4,5,2,6,7]
B-source interface (affine VCVS) is acceptable as analog behavioral element representing resistor network
Threshold voltages (rpeak_threshold, vth_14, vth_69, etc.) may use ideal V-sources (represent on-chip trimming)
Must not modify classifier weights, mirror calibration, or ReRAM conductances
dependencies: MAJOR-003 (COMPLETE — no ideal elements in signal path)
risk_factors: Convergence: Combined system has ~200+ MOSFETs, 1664 ReRAM cells, ~25 MIM caps. May need careful timestep control.
Frontend .ic elimination: Timer and EWMA caps need proper initial conditions or startup sequence. May need startup transient before feature extraction begins.
Loading effects: Frontend source followers may be loaded differently when driving B-source inputs vs standalone ideal measurement.
LDO design: Simple resistive divider won't regulate under varying load. May need active regulator or accept that frontend load is essentially constant.
Simulation time: Full transient with both blocks may take 30+ minutes per beat.
